mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the risk-free rate and lowers the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A PAYEMS level above 150 million (indicating a tight labor market) signals strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS not declining) signals persistent inflationary pressures and restrictive monetary policy, which compresses corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL>3.5 and FEDFUNDS>=2.1), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 108.0) signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL>3.5 and INDPRO<108.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in high-inflation regimes is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST above 1200 thousand units) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS level above 510 billion (indicating robust consumer spending) signals strong economic activity and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 510000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150000) signals an overheating labor market that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE<3.5 and PAYEMS>150000), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a hard landing regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), restrictive monetary policy combined with high inflation signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS>2.5 and CPIAUCSL>3.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.
